detail.longDescription: The web just shifted from "reading links" to "executing code." ⚡️ Google Search I/O 2026 changes everything: AI Agents can now discover, authenticate, and call your endpoints directly. If your site isn't agent-ready, you're invisible. Here is the complete breakdown covering: 🔹 JSON-LD & OpenAPI setup 🔹 Agentic SEO & manifest signals 🔹 OAuth 2.1 & Prompt Injection defenses Read the full guide: https://www. a1ho.com/2026/08/from-tools-to -teammates-why-google_1.html # AIAgents # SEO # WebDev # CyberSecurity # GoogleIO
